name: TiC-LM
intro: TiC-LM 是一个用于时间连续语言模型预训练的网络规模基准。它包含一个源自114个Common Crawl（CC）数据转储的大规模时间分层数据集，比以前的基准大几个数量级。该基准还设计了跨通用领域（CC数据）和特定领域（维基百科、StackExchange和代码文档）的时间分层评估，以评估持续学习方法在适应新数据的同时保留过去知识的能力。
build_method: 114个月度Common Crawl转储, 月内模糊去重, 因果时序切分
metric: Perplexity, Backward/In-distribution/Forward Performance, Forgetting, Forward Transfer
eval_feature: 长文本, 动态, 实时
build_method_en: 114 monthly Common Crawl dumps, within-month fuzzy deduplication, causal temporal splits
intro_en: TiC-LM is a network scale benchmark for pretraining time-continuous language models. It includes a large-scale time-layered dataset derived from 114 Common Crawl (CC) data dumps, several orders of magnitude larger than previous benchmarks. The benchmark also features time-layered evaluations across general domains (CC data) and specific domains (Wikipedia, StackExchange, and code documentation) to assess continual learning methods' ability to retain past knowledge while adapting to new data.
metric_en: Perplexity, Backward/In-distribution/Forward Performance, Forgetting, Forward Transfer

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TiC-LM arXiv:2504.02107, Sections 2-4; official apple/ml-tic-lm repository. TiC-LM processes 114 monthly Common Crawl dumps from May 2013 through July 2024 with resiliparse, RefinedWeb-style filtering, and fuzzy deduplication confined within each month so future data cannot affect the past. It deliberately avoids a future-dependent learned quality classifier. The result is the 2.9-trillion-token TiC-CC training corpus plus chronological CC, Wikipedia, news, StackExchange, and code-documentation evaluations. Continual models consume months in order, optionally with replay or regularization, and are compared with periodic-retraining oracles. Evaluation reports temporal perplexity, backward/in-distribution/forward performance, forgetting and transfer, plus static DCLM Core tasks.
